verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26167109 from Karton Nowak to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318614 (dated 2026-01-22). One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-005 Cover Sleeve Grand Heist 5 (USK/PEGI), 110,000 pcs at 0.06 EUR, confirmed delivery date 2026-02-20. Terms: DAP Hamburg, NET30. No corrections, stamps or handwriting.
observations: Printed PDF, single page, no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The document has no issue date of its own; only the order date (2026-01-22) and confirmed date (2026-02-20) appear.
The quantity column is headed 'Qty' with no unit given; it is recorded as quantity_confirmed.
The 'Confirmed' column holds the date 2026-02-20; I read it as the confirmed delivery date.
